claims.quote: Cobitis hugowolfeldi (formerly Iksookimia hugowolfeldi) is a cobitid loach endemic to Korea, known from the Yeongsan and Tamjin river systems in the province of Jeollanam-do.

All Iksookimia species are endemic to Korea, with I. hugowolfeldi restricted to the south-western province of Jeollanam-do (South Jeolla) where it's known from the Yeongsan and Tamjin river systems plus some minor drainages.
Type locality is 'Yung San River, South Korea'.
